items.title: Stefon Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2020
items.q: it’s been great, honestly, to see president-elect Biden use the word empathy as much as he does

ctx.x: I look back, prior to our current administration, and I think what’s at the center of what brought us to this situation is a lack of empathy. I’m going to always go back to empathy. And I should preface it by saying that I don’t think that empathy has morality. Empathy is not good or bad, empathy has been used for evil throughout history, and it’s been used for good. The most important thing though is to be able to quiet the ego first and to listen and to understand the environment in which your ideas exist. And…

the person in front of you. No judgement at all. Then once it’s there then you can have some sense of judgement in whichever way you choose. And then it’s up to your moral code. It’s about how you will behave. But I don’t think we’re in a situation right now where we have been paying attention to one another. And it’s been great, honestly, to see president-elect Biden use the word empathy as much as he does because I think that’s what’s going to need to happen to get the gears of our Congress working properly.
Well thank you for sharing that. So Michelle do we have any folks who would like to ask something of Mr. Harris?
